rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for the act or words of boasting.

example.english: All his talk about knowing everything is just a boast.
example.traditional: 佢成日話自己乜都識，真係吹牛。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 mat1 dou1 sik1 zan1 hai6 ceoi1 ngau4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone boasts through exaggerated or boastful talk.

example.english: They boast all the time that they know everyone in the world.
example.traditional: 佢成日吹水話自己識晒全世界啲人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ceoi1 seoi2 waa6 zi6 gei2 sik1 saai3 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 di1 jan4

rows.note: Use this as the straightforward equivalent when explicitly saying that someone praises themselves boastfully.

example.english: The company uses its annual report to boast about its recent achievements.
example.traditional: 公司喺年度報告中吹噓近年嘅成績。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 hai2 nin4 dou6 bou3 gou3 zung1 ceoi1 heoi1 gan6 nin4 ge3 sing4 zik1

rows.note: Use this when the boasting involves showing off achievements, possessions, or status.

example.english: They always boast that their car is very expensive.
example.traditional: 佢成日晒命，話自己部車好貴。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 saai3 meng6 waa6 zi6 gei2 bou6 ce1 hou2 gwai3

rows.note: Use this fixed phrase for conspicuous self-praise, especially in more formal or written contexts.

example.english: This report arguably seems to boast about its own achievements.
example.traditional: 呢份報告未免有自吹自擂之嫌。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 mei6 min5 jau5 zi6 ceoi1 zi6 leoi4 zi1 jim4

rows.note: Use this for an achievement, quality, or other thing that someone can show off about, rather than for the boastful talk itself.

example.english: This award is his biggest boast.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zoeng2 hai6 keoi5 zeoi3 wai1 seoi2 je5
